notes.title: I OFFERED YOU THE CROWN Release Celebration!
notes.content: [p]Winter Twilight Productions is thrilled to release our second game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3635280/I_Offered_You_the_Crown/"]I OFFERED YOU THE CROWN![/url] We're celebrating with our biggest discount ever on our first game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2929180/We_Need_Space/"]WE NEED SPACE.[/url] Blast off on our comedy space adventure and rediscover your love of coffee ice cream you never knew you had. Thanks for playing![/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixes - And an Announcment!
notes.content:
Included a link to other games by Winter Twilight Productions.

We have a new visual novel coming out! Check out and wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3635280/I_Offered_You_the_Crown/]I OFFERED YOU THE CROWN[/url], coming out on July 16th!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: We Need Space 1.05 Is Live!
notes.content:
Music levels have been upped a bit so you can more easily hear the smooth, smooth sounds of space music as it lifts you to newfound heights of adventure. Thank you for playing!
